memories.text: Neth planting the hedge along the east path, laughing at how crooked it went. It is still crooked.
The winter fever. The sound the house made afterwards, which was nothing.
Wren on the road out, not looking back. I did not call after her. I should have.
Forty-one harvests. The good ones blur together. The bad ones I can name.
Sat with Odile. Comfortable quiet, mostly.
Went to the temple and asked for word from my daughter Wren. Said it out loud, which was harder than expected.

memories.text: The river at night. I was four. I remember being carried away from the bank, not toward it.
Eating at a different house every night for six years. Everyone was kind. Nobody was mine.
The water-wheel turning for the first time. It ran eight days. Best eight days.
Bram let me sharpen his scythe once and said it was "not bad". I think about that a lot.
